sentences.en: On the 12th of January 1965,
Marianne Schmidt and Christine Sharrick, both aged 15, were found murdered on a desolate, isolated stretch of beach just north of Penella, south of Sydney.
sentences.zh: 15岁的玛丽安·施密特和克里斯汀·沙里克被发现死在悉尼以南、佩内拉以北一片荒凉偏僻的海滩上。

sentences.en: The case would come to be known as the Wanda Beach Murders.
sentences.zh: 这起案件后来被称为“万达海滩谋杀案”。

sentences.en: One mention of the word Wanda is enough to send chills down the spine of those who remember the
sentences.zh: 只要提到“万达”这个词，就足以让那些记得这起案件的人不寒而栗，

sentences.en: case that dominated the television reports, radio airwaves and print media of the day.
sentences.zh: 当时这起案件占据了电视报道、广播电台和报纸媒体的头条。

sentences.en: The killing sparked one of the biggest manhunts Australia has ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这起杀人案引发了澳大利亚历史上最大规模的搜捕行动之一。

sentences.en: The police file on the case is over 10,000 pages long and over 14,000 people have been interviewed.
sentences.zh: 该案的警方档案长达一万多页，接受过问话的人数超过一万四千人。

sentences.en: Police efforts to solve the case have been described as exhaustive and leads have been followed up all around Australia.
sentences.zh: 警方为破案所做的努力被形容为“穷尽一切手段”，线索追踪遍布全澳大利亚。

sentences.en: Despite the best efforts of police no charges have ever been laid and the case remains unsolved to this day.
sentences.zh: 尽管警方竭尽全力，但至今无人被起诉，案件至今仍未侦破。

sentences.en: The Wanda case contains many more questions than answers.
sentences.zh: 万达案留下的疑问远多于答案。

sentences.en: What drew Mary Ann and Christine to the Wanda Sandhills that day?
sentences.zh: 那天是什么把玛丽安和克里斯汀吸引到了万达沙丘？

sentences.en: Had they prearranged to meet someone?
sentences.zh: 她们是提前约好了要见什么人吗？

sentences.en: Were they just in the wrong place at the wrong time?
sentences.zh: 还是她们只是在错误的时间出现在了错误的地点？

sentences.en: Speculation and many different theories have surrounded the case since day one.
sentences.zh: 从案发第一天起，各种猜测和理论就层出不穷。

sentences.en: Only one thing is clear, a vicious and ruthless killer has never been brought to justice.
sentences.zh: 唯一明确的是，一个残忍无情的凶手至今仍未被绳之以法。

sentences.zh: 施密特一家住在克里斯汀·沙里克的隔壁，克里斯汀当时正和祖父母吉姆和珍妮特·泰格住在布拉什路。

sentences.en: Christine's father had recently passed away and her mother had remarried and so Christine elected to live with her grandparents.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀的父亲刚去世不久，母亲改嫁了，所以克里斯汀选择和祖父母住在一起。

sentences.en: Christine and Maryam formed an instant bond.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀和玛丽安一见如故。

sentences.zh: 她们总是形影不离，感情好得不得了。

sentences.en: Christine's uncle described of their friendship, they did not go out much and their main interests were centered around their homes.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀的叔叔在描述她们的友谊时说，她们不怎么出门，主要的兴趣都围绕着家庭。

sentences.en: They were always in each other's company and neither went out with boys.
sentences.zh: 她们总是待在一起，而且谁也不跟男孩子出去玩。

sentences.en: Both girls were described as quiet, well-behaved, they were good in school, they tend to church regularly with their parents.
sentences.zh: 两个女孩都被描述为安静、乖巧，在学校表现良好，经常和父母一起去教堂。

sentences.en: They weren't known to hang around any unsavoury characters or even described as being somewhat shy.

sentences.en: And like any other teenage girls, they had a love of the beach, they had an interest in music, special mention for Elvis, and of

sentences.zh: 珍妮特知道万达沙丘距离克罗努拉海滩的主区有两公里远，便回答说：“今天别去了，亲爱的，

sentences.zh: 克里斯汀试图争辩，但祖母再次叮嘱：“别去沙丘。”

sentences.en: So what are the Wanda Sandhills and what were the girls seemingly fascination with them?
sentences.zh: 那么万达沙丘到底是什么地方？女孩们为什么似乎对它如此着迷？

sentences.en: The Wanda Sandhills, otherwise known as
sentences.zh: 万达沙丘，又名

sentences.en: Greenhills, run behind Wanda Beach and continue north up to Kernel.
sentences.zh: “绿丘”，位于万达海滩后方，一直向北延伸至克内尔。

sentences.en: Wanda is an Aboriginal name meaning sandhills by the sea beach.
sentences.zh: “万达”是一个原住民名字，意为“海边的沙丘”。

sentences.en: Wanda Beach is part of a longer stretch of beach coastline that starts with Grinola Beach, includes North Grinola Beach, Allura Beach and then Wanda Beach.
sentences.zh: 万达海滩是更长海岸线的一部分，这条海岸线始于格里诺拉海滩，包括北格里诺拉海滩、阿卢拉海滩，然后才是万达海滩。

sentences.en: The distance from the main Grinola Beach to the Wanda sandhills is about two kilometers and then the sandhills themselves run a lot longer past that.
sentences.zh: 从格里诺拉海滩主区到万达沙丘的距离大约有两公里，而沙丘本身还要向北延伸很长一段距离。

sentences.en: The area in and around Wanda Surf Club and the main beach area itself were clean and pristine but the Wanda sandhills were a very different isolated story.
sentences.zh: 万达冲浪俱乐部及其周边区域和主海滩区本身干净整洁，但万达沙丘却是另一番荒凉景象。

sentences.en: In 1965, Wandersandhills were described as Sydney's filthiest and loneliest stretch of
sentences.zh: 1965年，万达沙丘被形容为悉尼最肮脏、最孤独的

sentences.en: beach, littered with smashed bottles, old chews, rusted cans, broken poise, any other amount of discarded junk and rubbish that you can think of.
sentences.zh: 海滩，到处都是碎瓶子、旧口香糖、生锈的罐头、破碎的陶器，以及你能想到的各种废弃垃圾。

sentences.en: This isolation meant the Wandersandhills were a perfect spot for people to meet up who didn't necessarily want to be seen.
sentences.zh: 这种与世隔绝的环境使得万达沙丘成为了那些不想被人看见的人见面的绝佳场所。

sentences.en: In 1965, it was a far, far more conservative time than what we experience today.
sentences.zh: 1965年的社会风气远比今天保守得多。

sentences.en: Incredibly, homosexuality was actually a criminal offence and it wouldn't be made legal for another 18 years.
sentences.zh: 令人难以置信的是，同性恋在当时实际上是一种刑事犯罪，直到18年后才被合法化。

sentences.en: The area was also known to attract nude sunbathers, other couples engaging in public sex, public masturbators, nudists.

sentences.en: There's general perverted types who like to spy on people engaging in sexual activity, who like to spy on women, who like to harass

sentences.en: It doesn't sound like the ideal place for two well-behaved, generally quiet, type 15-year-old girls to go.
sentences.zh: 这听起来并不是两个乖巧、安静的15岁女孩该去的地方。

sentences.en: But remember, Christine and Marianne weren't from the local area.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，克里斯汀和玛丽安不是本地人。

sentences.en: Not even really close.

sentences.zh: 带他去了一个浅水且更隐蔽的地方快速游了一会儿。之后她们回到其他人身边，

sentences.en: ate lunch at the rocks at some time while they were around the rocks wolfgang saw marianne and
sentences.zh: 在岩石旁吃了午餐。在岩石附近时，沃尔夫冈看到玛丽安和

sentences.en: Christine talking to a boy.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀正在和一个男孩交谈。

sentences.en: He was described as being 16 years old, medium build, long fair hair and he was hunting for crabs at the time with a homemade spear.
sentences.zh: 据描述，他大约16岁，中等身材，留着长长的金发，当时正拿着自制的鱼叉捕蟹。

sentences.en: Wolfgang couldn't hear what they were talking about.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫冈听不清他们在谈论什么。

sentences.en: Shortly after they ate lunch Marianne suggested going for a walk up to the sandhills at Wanda.
sentences.zh: 午餐后不久，玛丽安提议去万达的沙丘走走。

sentences.en: The others agreed so they left their belongings at the rocks and all walked north beginning their two kilometre journey to the sandhills.
sentences.zh: 其他人同意了，于是他们把行李留在岩石旁，一起向北开始了前往沙丘的两公里路程。

sentences.en: But as they got to Wanda Beach the walk had become too much for the younger children.
sentences.zh: 但当他们到达万达海滩时，对于年幼的孩子来说，这段路太长了。

sentences.en: The wind was howling, it was whipping up the sand, stinging their legs, so Wolfgang found a spot that was sheltered from the wind.
sentences.zh: 风呼啸着，卷起沙子打在腿上很疼，于是沃尔夫冈找了一个避风的地方。

sentences.en: Marianne and Christine told the younger kids to stay put and they would go back south to grab their belongings from the rocks so they could organize to start heading home.
sentences.zh: 玛丽安和克里斯汀让弟弟妹妹们待在那里，她们回去南边取回岩石旁的行李，以便准备回家。

sentences.en: They mentioned there'd be about 20 minutes, but clearly Marianne and Christine had no intention of going home just yet.
sentences.zh: 她们说大约20分钟就回来，但显然玛丽安和克里斯汀还没打算回家。

sentences.en: Instead of walking south back to where their gear was, they continued north to the sandhills.
sentences.zh: 她们没有往南走回放行李的地方，而是继续向北走向沙丘。

sentences.en: Peter yelled out, you're going the wrong way.
sentences.zh: 彼得大喊：“你们走错方向了！”

sentences.en: The girls just looked back and laughed and kept walking into the sandhills.
sentences.zh: 女孩们回头笑了笑，继续走进沙丘。

sentences.en: It's the last time Norbert, Peter and Trixie ever saw Christine and Marianne alive.
sentences.zh: 那是诺伯特、彼得和特里西最后一次见到活着的克里斯汀和玛丽安。

sentences.en: After about 10 minutes, Peter sent Wolfgang to look for the girls.
sentences.zh: 大约10分钟后，彼得派沃尔夫冈去找她们。

sentences.en: Wolfgang walked to the sandhills and it's here that he sees Marianne and Christine talking to a boy.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫冈走到沙丘，在那里他看到玛丽安和克里斯汀正在和一个男孩交谈。

sentences.en: He describes this boy as being a big boy, aged 16, long fair hair, had white cream on his nose, carrying a blue towel, wearing light grey trousers.
sentences.zh: 他描述这个男孩是个大个子，16岁，长金发，鼻子上涂着白色的防晒霜，带着一条蓝色毛巾，穿着浅灰色长裤。

sentences.en: He didn't have a shirt on and he was quite suntanned so basically he described him as a surfy looking type boy.
sentences.zh: 他没穿上衣，晒得很黑，所以他基本上形容他是一个“冲浪男孩”类型的少年。

sentences.en: Wolfgang says that the surfy boy looked angry and he was asking the girls their names.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫冈说那个冲浪男孩看起来很生气，正在问女孩们叫什么名字。

sentences.en: He decided against following them any further and and the girls disappeared with the mail into the sandhills.
sentences.zh: 他决定不再跟过去，女孩们就和那个男孩一起消失在沙丘里了。

sentences.en: About 10 minutes later, Wolfgang saw the surfy team walking back out of the sandhills.
sentences.zh: 大约10分钟后，沃尔夫冈看到那个冲浪男孩独自从沙丘里走出来。

sentences.en: He was alone.
sentences.zh: 他是一个人。

sentences.en: There was no sight of the girls.
sentences.zh: 没看到女孩们的身影。

sentences.en: He now had the blue towel tied around his neck.
sentences.zh: 他现在把那条蓝色毛巾系在脖子上。

sentences.en: Wolfgang actually asked the surfy, where are the girls?
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫冈问那个冲浪男孩：“女孩们在哪儿？”

sentences.en: But he didn't answer, and he just walked straight past him.
sentences.zh: 但他没有回答，直接从他身边走了过去。

sentences.en: Have the Peter, Trixie, or Norbert ever reported seeing this surfy team?
sentences.zh: 彼得、特里西或诺伯特是否曾报告过看到这个冲浪男孩？

sentences.en: Wolfgang's story of this encounter is subject of much debate.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫冈关于这次相遇的说法一直备受争议。

sentences.en: It actually changed a few times and sort of evolved over several interviews.
sentences.zh: 他的说法变过几次，在多次采访中逐渐演变。

sentences.en: He kept adding vital pieces of information as time went on.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他不断补充关键信息。

sentences.en: Now, there could be many reasons why this happened,
sentences.zh: 现在，造成这种情况的原因可能有很多，

sentences.en: but it was a source of frustration for detectives at the time, and as such, Wolfgang's version has been treated with a little bit of scepticism.
sentences.zh: 但这在当时是侦探们感到沮丧的根源，因此，沃尔夫冈的说法一直受到一点怀疑。

sentences.en: We can only speculate why the girls walked into the sandhills that day.
sentences.zh: 我们只能推测女孩们那天为什么走进沙丘。

sentences.en: They were obviously determined to go there.
sentences.zh: 她们显然是铁了心要去那里。

sentences.en: Christine had mentioned it to her grandmother that morning and her grandmother told her not to go.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀那天早上曾向祖母提起过，但祖母告诉她不要去。

sentences.en: It was a two kilometre walk with young children in howling wind, poor weather conditions.
sentences.zh: 在狂风和恶劣的天气条件下，带着年幼的孩子走两公里路程，

sentences.en: It makes that two kilometres that much more longer.
sentences.zh: 这让那两公里的路显得格外漫长。

sentences.en: And not only that, the actual sandhills themselves stretched for kilometres further past that point.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，真正的沙丘地带在那一点之后还向外延伸了数公里。

sentences.en: This convinced many people that they had planned to meet someone at the sandhills that day.
sentences.zh: 这让许多人确信，她们那天是计划在沙丘与某人见面。

sentences.en: Certainly that was the initial police theory that they went with in the early stages of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 当然，这确实是警方在调查初期所持的初步理论。

sentences.en: One factor though is that Christina Marion had originally planned to go to the beach the day before If you remember they cancelled due to poor weather
sentences.zh: 不过有一个因素是，克里斯蒂娜·马里昂原本计划前一天去海滩，如果你还记得的话，她们因为天气不好取消了行程。

sentences.en: And their plans had changed and they were now there on the Monday
sentences.zh: 她们的计划变了，现在她们是在周一去了那里。

sentences.en: If they were planning to meet someone pre-arranged It wasn't as easy to reschedule back then as it is today with mobile phones and social media
sentences.zh: 如果她们确实计划与某人预先安排见面，在那个没有手机和社交媒体的年代，重新安排时间并不像今天这么容易。

sentences.en: So if they were in fact planning to meet someone in those sandhills that day it's far more likely that they met that someone that day, Monday the 11th of January.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果她们那天确实计划在沙丘与某人见面，那么她们更有可能是在那天，即1月11日星期一，见到了那个人。

sentences.en: After Wolfgang lost sight of Christine and Marianne, a witness, Dennis Dostein, describes seeing the girls hurried through the signals.
sentences.zh: 在沃尔夫冈失去克里斯汀和玛丽安的踪影后，一名目击者丹尼斯·多斯坦描述说，看到女孩们匆忙穿过信号灯。

sentences.en: Dennis is actually the last named person to see the girls alive.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯实际上是最后一位被点名看到女孩们活着的人。

sentences.en: He says, Christine and Marianne were walking faSt.
sentences.zh: 他说，克里斯汀和玛丽安走得很快。

sentences.en: They appeared to be in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 她们看起来很匆忙。

sentences.en: They were about 800 meters away from where their bodies were found at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时她们距离发现尸体的地方大约有800米。

sentences.en: One of the girls was constantly looking over her shoulder as if someone was following them.
sentences.zh: 其中一个女孩不断回头看，好像有人在跟踪她们一样。

sentences.en: Dennis had a bit of a look but he couldn't see anyone, didn't seem suspicious so he didn't think too much more of it.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯回头看了一眼，但没看到任何人，也没觉得有什么可疑，所以他没再多想。

sentences.en: While Marianne and
sentences.zh: 当玛丽安和

sentences.en: Christine were gone Wolfgang, Norbert, Peter and Trixie continued to wait.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀离开后，沃尔夫冈、诺伯特、彼得和特里西继续等待。

sentences.en: After a while Peter, Trixie and Wolfgang had another look around for the girls.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，彼得、特里西和沃尔夫冈又四处寻找女孩们。

sentences.en: They couldn't find them, there was no trace of them.
sentences.zh: 他们找不到她们，一点踪迹都没有。

sentences.en: At no stage did Wolfgang make mention of the surfy team.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫冈自始至终都没有提到过那个冲浪少年。

sentences.en: After a few hours of waiting they became aware time was slipping away.
sentences.zh: 等待了几个小时后，他们意识到时间在流逝。

sentences.en: The last train out of Cronulla was at 6 p.m.
sentences.zh: 离开克罗纳拉的最后一班火车是下午6点。

sentences.en: and they had to get there.
sentences.zh: 他们必须赶上那班车。

sentences.en: So they made the journey back down to the southern end of Cronulla Beach.
sentences.zh: 于是他们踏上了返回克罗纳拉海滩南端的路程。

sentences.en: They found their belongings where they had left them on the rocks.
sentences.zh: 他们在岩石上找到了她们留下的物品。

sentences.en: They were untouched.
sentences.zh: 它们原封未动。

sentences.en: They made the last train out of Cronulla and arrived home at about 8pm.
sentences.zh: 他们赶上了离开克罗纳拉的最后一班火车，大约晚上8点到家。

sentences.en: Alma Jr and Christine's grandparents were made aware of Christine and Marion's disappearance and the police were called.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛二世和克里斯汀的祖父母得知了克里斯汀和马里昂失踪的消息，并报了警。

sentences.en: No major alarm bells went off for the police who attended to take the missing persons report.
sentences.zh: 负责处理失踪人口报告的警察并没有拉响警报。

sentences.en: They arrived just before midnight.
sentences.zh: 他们午夜前赶到。

sentences.en: Two 15-year-old girls, the best of friends, they were out for a day at the beach.
sentences.zh: 两个15岁的女孩，最好的朋友，她们只是去海滩玩了一天。

sentences.en: they walked off under no duress or threat, they were happy, they were laughing.
sentences.zh: 她们是在没有受到胁迫或威胁的情况下离开的，她们很开心，还在笑。

sentences.en: The usual questions would have been asked, have they done this before?
sentences.zh: 通常会问的问题是，她们以前这样做过吗？

sentences.en: Is there anywhere you think they might be?
sentences.zh: 你认为她们可能在什么地方吗？

sentences.en: Could they be at a friend's place?
sentences.zh: 她们会在朋友家吗？

sentences.en: Do they have boyfriends?
sentences.zh: 她们有男朋友吗？

sentences.en: Of some concern though for police was that it was out of character for them.
sentences.zh: 不过，让警方有些担忧的是，这不符合她们的性格。

sentences.en: They had happy home lives, they were well behaved, they'd never run off before.
sentences.zh: 她们家庭生活幸福，表现良好，以前从未离家出走过。

sentences.en: So they're not the types just to sort of go missing without letting anyone know where they were and especially to leave four young children at the beach alone.
sentences.zh: 所以她们不是那种不告诉任何人去向就失踪的人，尤其是把四个年幼的孩子单独留在海滩上。

sentences.en: The report was broadcast to all police stations in the Sydney area.
sentences.zh: 这份报告被广播到悉尼地区的所有警察局。

sentences.en: Of course, the police around Cronulla and the surrounding patrols would have been paying much more attention than the others.
sentences.zh: 当然，克罗纳拉及其周边巡逻队的警察会比其他人更加关注。

sentences.en: And just imagine how different it was back then in 1965.
sentences.zh: 试想一下，在1965年那个年代，情况有多么不同。

sentences.en: There was no mobile phones to track, no social media accounts to check, no instant media releases that could go viral and keep the public on the lookout.
sentences.zh: 没有手机可以追踪，没有社交媒体账号可以核查，没有可以迅速传播并让公众保持警惕的即时媒体发布。

sentences.en: There was none of that.
sentences.zh: 这些统统都没有。

sentences.en: But even if all that modern technology was in existence, it would have been too late.
sentences.zh: 但即使所有这些现代技术都存在，也已经太晚了。

sentences.en: Christine and Marianne were already dead.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀和玛丽安已经死了。

sentences.en: About 2.30pm on the 12th of January 1965 Peter Smith aged 17 was walking through the sandhills with his two younger nephews.
sentences.zh: 1965年1月12日下午2点30分左右，17岁的彼得·史密斯带着他的两个小侄子走在沙丘中。

sentences.en: He saw what he initially thought was a store mannequin lying in the sand.
sentences.zh: 他看到了一个起初以为是躺在沙子里的商店人体模型的东西。

sentences.en: He went in and had a closer look and it was there that the grim reality of what he had found became clear.
sentences.zh: 他走近仔细一看，就在那时，他所发现的残酷现实变得清晰起来。

sentences.en: Filled with shock, horror, panic
sentences.zh: 充满震惊、恐惧、恐慌，

sentences.en: Peter ran to Wanda Surf Club It was about 1500 metres away to the south
sentences.zh: 彼得跑向万达冲浪俱乐部，那里距离南边大约1500米。

sentences.en: He notified the caretaker Barry Yezzy that he'd found the dead body of a young girl and he asked to use a phone so he could call police
sentences.zh: 他通知了看守人巴里·耶齐，说他发现了一具年轻女孩的尸体，并要求借用电话报警。

sentences.en: Police arrived, they met Peter at Wanda Surf Club and then he led them up to the burial site On closer inspection of the scene it was noticed by a police officer
sentences.zh: 警察赶到，在万达冲浪俱乐部与彼得会合，然后他带他们去了埋尸地点。在对现场进行更仔细的检查时，一名警官注意到，

sentences.en: that there were three feet sticking out from under the seer not two and the already horrific discovery became that much more horrific
sentences.zh: 从沙子下露出了三只脚，而不是两只，而这个已经令人毛骨悚然的发现变得更加可怕，

sentences.en: when it was discovered that there were two bodies, not one.
sentences.zh: 因为发现那里有两具尸体，而不是一具。

sentences.en: Now, they weren't really buried as such.
sentences.zh: 其实，她们并没有真正被埋葬。

sentences.en: It was just sort of covered with sand and not that deep.
sentences.zh: 只是被沙子覆盖，埋得并不深。

sentences.en: The wind overnight had blown the sand off.
sentences.zh: 一夜的风把沙子吹开了。

sentences.en: Local Cronulla detectives soon notified the Criminal Investigation Branch
sentences.zh: 当地克罗纳拉侦探很快通知了刑事调查分部，

sentences.en: and more specialist detectives made their way to Wando, including the initial officer in charge of the case,
sentences.zh: 更多的专业侦探赶往万达，包括案件的最初负责人，

sentences.en: Detective Inspector Haynes.
sentences.zh: 海恩斯侦探督察。

sentences.en: The Director of Forensic Medicine, Dr Lang, and his assistant, Dr Brighton, also attended.
sentences.zh: 法医主任朗博士和他的助手布莱顿博士也出席了。

sentences.en: They thoroughly examined the crime scene and portable lighting had to be brought in so they could continue their work into the night.
sentences.zh: 他们彻底检查了犯罪现场，不得不带来便携式照明设备，以便他们能连夜继续工作。

sentences.en: It didn't take long for police to link the gruesome discovery to the missing person report of Christine and Mary Ann.
sentences.zh: 警方很快就将这一可怕的发现与克里斯汀和玛丽安的失踪报告联系了起来。

sentences.en: And not long after this, a positive identification was made.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，身份得到了确认。

sentences.en: The crime scene itself was two sandhills back from where they started on the beach side,
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场本身距离她们在海滩一侧开始的地方有两个沙丘之远，

sentences.en: 150 metres from the water's edge and about 1,500 metres north of Wanda Surf Club.
sentences.zh: 距离水边150米，距离万达冲浪俱乐部以北约1500米。

sentences.en: Despite not being at the beach that day, Hans Schmidt visited the scene later on and he had this to say about it.
sentences.zh: 尽管那天不在海滩，汉斯·施密特后来还是参观了现场，并对此发表了看法。

sentences.en: The place the girls were killed was very isolated even though it was only two dunes back from the beach.
sentences.zh: 女孩们被杀的地方非常偏僻，尽管距离海滩只有两个沙丘之远。

sentences.en: It was so quiet I couldn't even hear the waves crashing.
sentences.zh: 那里太安静了，我甚至听不到海浪拍打的声音。

sentences.en: You could scream your head off and no one would hear a thing.
sentences.zh: 你就算喊破喉咙，也不会有人听到。

sentences.en: No one could have heard the girls screaming for help.
sentences.zh: 没有人能听到女孩们呼救的尖叫声。

sentences.en: Blood and signs of a struggle were located 32 meters away from where the bodies lay and there was a drag mark going all the way from this site back to
sentences.zh: 在距离尸体所在位置32米处发现了血迹和挣扎的痕迹，有一条拖拽痕迹一直从这个地点延伸到

sentences.en: where Christine and Marianne were.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀和玛丽安所在的地方。

sentences.en: An examination of the scene led Detective Inspector Haynes to say this.
sentences.zh: 对现场的检查促使海恩斯侦探督察说了这样的话。

sentences.en: It looks as though the Schmidt girl was knocked down and then stabbed.
sentences.zh: 看起来施密特家的女孩是被击倒然后被刺伤的。

sentences.en: Christine was killed about 20 yards away and her body was then dragged back to where the Schmidt girl lay.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀在约20码外被杀，她的尸体随后被拖回施密特家女孩躺着的地方。

sentences.en: It's believed Christine witnessed Marianne being attacked and then ran off only to be caught a short distance away.
sentences.zh: 据信，克里斯汀目睹了玛丽安遭到袭击，然后跑开，结果在不远处被抓住。

sentences.en: At intervals of about every three meters along the drive marks there were much heavier concentrations of blood.
sentences.zh: 沿着拖拽痕迹，大约每隔三米就有更浓重的血迹。

sentences.en: These heavier concentrations were consistent with the person who was dragging the body, stopping for arreSt. Christine was slim, described as a
sentences.zh: 这些更浓重的血迹与拖拽尸体的人停下来休息的情况相符。克里斯汀身材苗条，被描述为一个

sentences.en: petite girl, so the implication here was clear.
sentences.zh: 娇小的女孩，所以这里的暗示很明确。

sentences.en: Whoever was dragging her may not have been that physically strong.
sentences.zh: 拖拽她的人可能体力并没有那么强。

sentences.en: Detectives also located car tracks about 30 metres west from where Christine was attacked, showing the killer could have fled the scene in a vehicle, although it's not known if
sentences.zh: 侦探们还在距离克里斯汀遇袭地点以西约30米处发现了车辙，显示凶手可能驾车逃离了现场，尽管尚不清楚

sentences.en: these tracks were related.
sentences.zh: 这些车辙是否相关。

sentences.en: The killer could have also easily escaped over the back of the sand hills towards Captain Cook Drive where he could have disappeared without ever being back on the main beach area.
sentences.zh: 凶手也可能很容易越过沙丘后方朝库克船长大道逃走，在那里他可以消失，而无需回到主海滩区域。

sentences.en: The post-mortem of the girls was conducted by the director of forensic medicine
sentences.zh: 女孩们的尸检由法医主任进行，

sentences.zh: 是大多数人甚至无法开始想象的。

sentences.zh: 他很可能处于严重的休克状态。

sentences.en: There's no such thing as grief counselling back then.
sentences.zh: 那时根本没有悲伤辅导这回事。

sentences.en: It was a much different time.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常不同的时代。

sentences.en: People just expected to suck it up and get on with it.

sentences.zh: 每一篇媒体报道，无论是电视、广播还是印刷品，都被关于女孩死前看到的冲浪少年嫌疑人的报道所占据。

sentences.en: It didn't take long for police to be swamped with calls and information about the teen surfy.
sentences.zh: 警方很快就被关于冲浪少年的电话和信息淹没了。

sentences.en: They received hundreds of calls a day.
sentences.zh: 他们每天接到数百个电话。

sentences.en: It was even revealed that a teen matching that description was kicked off Wanda Beach only a few days before the killings for harassing young girls.
sentences.zh: 甚至有消息称，一名符合该描述的少年在杀人案发生前几天就因为骚扰年轻女孩而被赶出了万达海滩。

sentences.en: The media ran wild and Police Commissioner Norman Allen made a public appeal for that surfy teen to come forward.
sentences.zh: 媒体疯狂报道，警察局长诺曼·艾伦公开呼吁那名冲浪少年站出来。

sentences.en: The hunt for the surfy teen was in full swing, leading to the media reporting that four suspects had been detained and were being questioned, one as far away as Queensland.
sentences.zh: 对冲浪少年的搜捕正如火如荼地进行，导致媒体报道称有四名嫌疑人被拘留并正在接受审问，其中一人远在昆士兰州。

sentences.en: The truth was that they were never really suspects at all, and the teenagers had just been arrested on other minor charges.

sentences.zh: 它大约一英寸长，有明显的刃口。

sentences.en: So yet another person was added to the list of suspicious people at the beach that day and like the others he was never identified either and he obviously never came forward.
sentences.zh: 于是，当天海滩上的可疑人员名单中又多了一人，和之前的人一样，他从未被确认身份，显然也从未主动现身。

sentences.en: On the 1st of February police thought they had what was their first major breakthrough in the case, discovering an important piece of evidence, or so they thought at the time.
sentences.zh: 2月1日，警方认为他们在案件中取得了第一个重大突破，发现了一件重要证据，或者说他们当时是这么认为的。

sentences.en: By this stage police had been placed permanently in the Wandersand Hills keeping watch.
sentences.zh: 此时，警方已在万达沙丘（Wanda Sandhills）部署了常驻警力进行监视。

sentences.en: It was hoped that some of the people that had been seen at the beach on the day of the murders
sentences.zh: 人们希望那些案发当天在海滩上被目击到的人中，

sentences.en: that hadn't yet come forward would be sighted or even hoped that the surfy team would show up again.
sentences.zh: 还有尚未现身的人会被发现，甚至希望那群冲浪者能再次出现。

sentences.en: Now of course they weren't in uniform, they were dressed as sunbabers so they were undercover if you will.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们没有穿制服，而是打扮成晒太阳的人，也就是所谓的便衣。

sentences.en: Now a police officer on Sandhill Watch located a blue towel washed up on the shore.
sentences.zh: 当时，一名在沙丘值守的警官在岸边发现了一条被冲上来的蓝色毛巾。

sentences.en: Of course the surfy team described by Wolfgang was carrying a blue towel so the towel was immediately set for scientific testing and it was hoped that this towel was the
sentences.zh: 当然，沃尔夫冈（Wolfgang）描述的那群冲浪者中有人带着蓝色毛巾，所以这条毛巾立即被送去进行科学鉴定，人们希望这条毛巾就是

sentences.en: one belonged to surfy team described by Wolfgang, but all it was was another frustrating dead end.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫冈描述的那群冲浪者所拥有的，但结果这又是一条令人沮丧的死胡同。

sentences.en: A 13 year old boy came forward when news broke of the tale in the media and he identified it as one that he had lost at the beach only a few days before.
sentences.zh: 当媒体报道了这个消息后，一名13岁的男孩站了出来，他认出那是他几天前在海滩上丢失的毛巾。

sentences.en: The large reward that was put up by the New South Wales government was leading to all types of people calling in.
sentences.zh: 新南威尔士州政府设立的高额悬赏金引来了各种各样的人打来电话。

sentences.en: The investigation started to become very frustrated by false leads, dead ends, hopes calls, false confessions, wives ringing up about their husbands, all sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 调查工作开始因虚假线索、死胡同、恶作剧电话、虚假供词、妻子举报丈夫等各种事情而变得非常受挫。

sentences.en: And by now anyone who resembled a surfy teen had a phone call made to police about them.
sentences.zh: 到了现在，任何长得像冲浪少年的人都会引来针对他们的报警电话。

sentences.en: And while no doubt most of the calls being made to police were well intentioned, the truth of the matter is it was hindering the investigation.
sentences.zh: 虽然毫无疑问，大多数打给警方的电话都是出于好意，但事实是，这反而阻碍了调查。

sentences.en: Every lead, every call that came in had to be chased down, followed up and that's where it's thought that vital information that was actually important to the case could be lost
sentences.zh: 每一条线索、每一个打进来的电话都必须进行追踪和跟进，而人们认为，案件中真正重要的关键信息，可能就在

sentences.en: amongst the pile of useless information that was coming in.
sentences.zh: 堆积如山的无用信息中丢失了。

sentences.en: In April 119, two 15-year-old girls were attacked near Carinbar train station, it's only a short distance away from Cronulla.
sentences.zh: 1966年4月，两名15岁女孩在卡林巴（Carinbar）火车站附近遇袭，那里距离克罗纳拉（Cronulla）只有很短的距离。

sentences.en: The girls were walking together near the train station when a 15-year-old male grabbed one of them.
sentences.zh: 女孩们在火车站附近同行时，一名15岁男性抓住了其中一人。

sentences.en: The girls immediately screamed and frightened the attacker off.
sentences.zh: 女孩们立即尖叫起来，吓跑了袭击者。

sentences.en: The description was very similar to that of circuit team provided by Wolfgang.
sentences.zh: 其外貌描述与沃尔夫冈提供的冲浪者团队非常相似。

sentences.en: So that certainly pushed the already frightened community further to the edge.
sentences.zh: 这无疑让本已惊恐的社区更加人心惶惶。

sentences.en: But the fact that the community was so much on edge, I mean, this could have been totally unrelated to the one in the case.
sentences.zh: 但社区如此紧张，我的意思是，这可能与本案完全无关。

sentences.en: It could have been any random teenager just approaching two girls to say hello or whatever and grab one of them and they've screamed and everyone's run off.
sentences.zh: 这可能只是任何随机的青少年走近两个女孩打招呼之类的，抓了其中一个，然后她们尖叫，大家都跑开了。

sentences.en: He didn't produce a knife or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 他没有掏出刀子或类似的东西。

sentences.en: The full details of the attack were never released.
sentences.zh: 袭击的全部细节从未公开。

sentences.en: So it's unclear exactly what happened, but no one was injured, certainly.
sentences.zh: 所以具体发生了什么尚不清楚，但可以肯定的是没有人受伤。

sentences.en: By April, police had waded through the sheer volume of information that had come in, and it led to the release of six sketches
sentences.zh: 到了4月，警方已经梳理完了海量的信息，这促使他们发布了六张素描图，

sentences.en: who they considered suspects and that they really wanted to speak to.
sentences.zh: 这些是他们认为的可疑人员，他们非常希望能与这些人谈谈。

sentences.en: This included men making sexual advances and comments towards women, the naked man seen walking through the sandhills,
sentences.zh: 其中包括对女性进行性骚扰和言语挑逗的男子、被看到走过沙丘的裸体男子，

sentences.en: another man exposing himself to women a few months after the murders on the beach, and, of course, the boy who had just attacked the two girls at Carring Bar.
sentences.zh: 还有在海滩谋杀案发生几个月后向女性暴露身体的另一名男子，当然，还有那个刚在卡林巴袭击了两名女孩的男孩。

sentences.en: Wolfgang was unable to help police with a sketch of the surfy team as it was just too agreeable
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫冈无法协助警方绘制冲浪者团队的素描，因为他太好说话了，

sentences.en: everything the sketch artist said they would go along with so it was impossible to make a sketch
sentences.zh: 素描画家说的每一句话他都点头同意，所以根本无法画出肖像，

sentences.en: but of particular interest to police out of these six men were two men who they thought would most be valuable to the investigation that they really wanted to identify
sentences.zh: 但在警方关注的这六个人中，有两人被认为对调查最有价值，他们非常想确认其身份，

sentences.en: the first came to be known as the fat man so he was described as a medium to plump build
sentences.zh: 第一个被称为“胖子”，他被描述为中等偏胖身材，

sentences.en: between 25 and 35 years old, about 5 feet 11 inches tall, slightly foreign in appearance.
sentences.zh: 年龄在25到35岁之间，身高约5英尺11英寸，外貌略带异国特征。

sentences.en: He was described as carrying an orange and white towel, wearing grey trousers and a white shirt.
sentences.zh: 据描述，他带着一条橙白相间的毛巾，穿着灰色长裤和白色衬衫。

sentences.en: He was carrying a radio and a newspaper at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时他带着收音机和一份报纸。

sentences.en: What he did, he approached several women on the base on the day of the murders and on the days leading up to the murders.
sentences.zh: 他在谋杀案当天及案发前几天，曾在海滩上接近过几名女性。

sentences.en: He had pornographic magazines with him and he was making inappropriate comments to women asking if they wanted to have
sentences.zh: 他随身带着色情杂志，并对女性发表不当评论，问她们是否想

sentences.en: look through the magazine asking them how the sex was in Sydney.
sentences.zh: 翻阅杂志，还问她们悉尼的性生活怎么样。

sentences.en: He mentioned that he was from South Australia.
sentences.zh: 他提到自己来自南澳大利亚州。

sentences.en: So police were very very keen to catch up with him but he along with so many others was never identified and he never came forward.
sentences.zh: 所以警方非常非常渴望找到他，但他和其他许多人一样，从未被确认身份，也从未主动现身。

sentences.en: Another man who was of particular interest to police was described as being 18 to 20 years old with a slim build light brown hair and
sentences.zh: 另一名警方特别感兴趣的男子被描述为18到20岁，身材苗条，浅棕色头发，

sentences.en: he was wearing a long-sleeved shirt tucked into a pair of fawn shorts and he had missing teeth he was also making inappropriate propositions to women asking to have sex with
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件长袖衬衫，扎进一条浅黄色的短裤里，缺了几颗牙。他还对女性进行不当挑逗，要求与

sentences.en: women offering them money things like that but again he was never identified either so it's
sentences.zh: 女性发生性关系，并提供金钱等，但同样，他从未被确认身份，所以

sentences.en: starting to get ridiculous now the amount of people that police wanted to speak to who they deemed to
sentences.zh: 现在警方想要谈话的人数多得离谱，他们被认为

sentences.en: be suspicious who were at the beach on the day of the murders that were never identified and who
sentences.zh: 是谋杀案当天在海滩上的可疑人员，但从未被确认身份，也

sentences.en: never came forward you'd think that they would come forward given what happened the brutal nature of
sentences.zh: 从未主动现身。考虑到所发生罪行的残忍性质，你本以为他们会站出来，

sentences.en: crimes but no they're out there somewhere who knows if they're still alive but if they are now's the time.
sentences.zh: 但没有，他们还在某个地方。谁知道他们是否还活着，但如果活着，现在是时候了。

sentences.en: On the 29th of May a group of youths came forward stating that they'd found a pair of
sentences.zh: 5月29日，一群年轻人站出来说，他们发现了一副

sentences.en: flippers and a homemade crab spear about a one kilometer away from where the girls were located.
sentences.zh: 脚蹼和一个自制的捕蟹叉，距离发现女孩尸体的地方约一公里。

sentences.en: Now they found these only a few days after the murder and so it's not clear why they waited until the 29th of May to come forward and hand it in or couldn't find that anywhere.
sentences.zh: 他们是在谋杀案发生几天后发现的，所以不清楚为什么他们等到5月29日才站出来上交，或者说在其他地方找不到。

sentences.en: But regardless, they made themselves named police and the flippers and the spear were handed in.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，他们向警方报了名，脚蹼和捕蟹叉也被上交了。

sentences.en: Wolfgang was re-interviewed, but he was unable to identify the spear.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫冈再次接受了采访，但他无法辨认那个叉子。

sentences.en: He couldn't remember if it's the same one that the boy who was crabbing on the rocks that Spoke to Miriam and Christine was using.
sentences.zh: 他不记得这是否就是那个在岩石上捕蟹、曾与米里亚姆（Miriam）和克里斯汀（Christine）交谈过的男孩所使用的那个。

sentences.en: It was a promising lead, but it didn't end up going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有希望的线索，但最终没有结果。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持了《案件档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: The investigation really started to stall and by the beginning of 1966, the amount of full-time detectives on the case had dropped from 40 down to eight.
sentences.zh: 调查工作确实开始陷入停滞，到1966年初，负责此案的全职侦探人数已从40人减少到8人。

sentences.en: It was still being worked hard, but they were just frustrated by the lack of ability to identify a number of people at the beach
sentences.zh: 工作仍在努力进行，但他们只是因为无法确认海滩上多人的身份而感到沮丧，

sentences.en: and the amount of useless information that was still coming in that they were wasting their time, basically.
sentences.zh: 而且源源不断涌入的无用信息让他们基本上是在浪费时间。

sentences.en: Police were still assigned to the Wanda Stanhills to watch for anything suspicious, but all that ended up in achieving was
sentences.zh: 警方仍被指派在万达沙丘监视任何可疑情况，但最终取得的成果仅仅是

sentences.en: they arrested a number of people for sexual-related offences, but it got them no closer to identifying the killer.
sentences.zh: 逮捕了一些性犯罪者，但这让他们离查出凶手并没有更近一步。

sentences.en: On the 29th of January 1966, another brutal murder shocked the nation.
sentences.zh: 1966年1月29日，又一起残忍的谋杀案震惊了全国。

sentences.en: 57-year-old Wilhelmina Kruger was found murdered at the Piccadilly Shopping Arcade in Wollongong where she worked as a cleaner.
sentences.zh: 57岁的威尔赫米娜·克鲁格（Wilhelmina Kruger）被发现死在伍伦贡（Wollongong）的皮卡迪利购物中心（Piccadilly Shopping Arcade），她在那里担任清洁工。

sentences.en: Wollongong is in close proximity to Wanda, it's less than an hour's drive away.
sentences.zh: 伍伦贡距离万达很近，车程不到一小时。

sentences.en: The murder was very horrific and it did bear similarities to the Wanda case, that of a frenzied knife attack.
sentences.zh: 这起谋杀案非常恐怖，确实与万达案有相似之处，都是疯狂的持刀袭击。

sentences.en: There were no suspects, no witnesses, there was a lack of physical evidence, no attempt was made to hide a body.
sentences.zh: 没有嫌疑人，没有目击者，缺乏物证，也没有试图隐藏尸体。

sentences.en: It led many to believe the murder of Wilhelmina Kruger was committed by the person responsible for
sentences.zh: 这让许多人相信，威尔赫米娜·克鲁格的谋杀案是由对

sentences.en: Wanda.
sentences.zh: 万达案负责的人所为。

sentences.en: And just weeks later, on the 26th of February, the body of Anna Dalinkoa was found on Old Illawarra Road, Menai, southwest of Sydney, again in close proximity to both Wanda and
sentences.zh: 仅仅几周后，即2月26日，安娜·达林科娃（Anna Dalinkoa）的尸体在悉尼西南部的梅奈（Menai）老伊拉瓦拉路（Old Illawarra Road）被发现，同样距离万达和

sentences.en: Wollongong.
sentences.zh: 伍伦贡很近。

sentences.en: She too had been the victim of a brutal frenzied knife attack, almost identical to the attack committed on Wilhelmina Kruger.
sentences.zh: 她也是残忍疯狂持刀袭击的受害者，与对威尔赫米娜·克鲁格的袭击几乎一模一样。

sentences.en: Anna was working as an escort at the time and she was last seen on the 16th of February 1966 leaving a club in King's Cross.
sentences.zh: 安娜当时是一名伴游，最后一次露面是在1966年2月16日离开国王十字区（King's Cross）的一家俱乐部。

sentences.en: She mentioned to a few friends in the club that she was going to meet a client and she was never seen alive again.
sentences.zh: 她曾对俱乐部里的几个朋友提到她要去见一个客户，之后就再也没有人见过她活着。

sentences.en: There was no witnesses, no suspects, a lack of physical evidence, no attempt made to hide the body.
sentences.zh: 没有目击者，没有嫌疑人，缺乏物证，也没有试图隐藏尸体。

sentences.en: In actual fact, the killer returned to where Anna was dumped and dragged the body out from behind the bushes closer to the road so she would be found.
sentences.zh: 事实上，凶手回到了抛尸地点，把尸体从灌木丛后面拖出来，靠近路边，以便被人发现。

sentences.en: Police are almost certain the murders of Anna Delancoa and Wilhelmina Kruger were committed by the same person.
sentences.zh: 警方几乎可以肯定，安娜·达林科娃和威尔赫米娜·克鲁格的谋杀案是同一个人所为。

sentences.en: It's never been proven that the Wanda case was linked to both those murders, but many suspect that they are.
sentences.zh: 万达案是否与这两起谋杀案有关联从未得到证实，但许多人怀疑它们有关。

sentences.en: Just like the Wanda case, the murders of Wilhelmina Kruger and Anna Dellenkoa remain unsolved.
sentences.zh: 就像万达案一样，威尔赫米娜·克鲁格和安娜·达林科娃的谋杀案至今未破。

sentences.en: On the 20th of April 1966, a coroner's inquest into the Wanda case was held.
sentences.zh: 1966年4月20日，针对万达案的验尸官调查举行。

sentences.en: The inquest was presided over by City Corridor Mr LooMs. The amount of detectives working the case full-time was now down to about six.
sentences.zh: 调查由城市验尸官卢姆斯先生（Mr Looms）主持。此时负责此案的全职侦探人数已降至约6人。

sentences.en: The investigation log totaled over 5,000 pages, and over 7,000 people had been interviewed.
sentences.zh: 调查日志总计超过5000页，已采访了超过7000人。

sentences.en: A large amount of witnesses gave evidence of the inquest including the all-important Schmidt children.
sentences.zh: 大量证人在调查中提供了证据，包括至关重要的施密特（Schmidt）家的孩子们。

sentences.en: The inquest lasted three days concluding on the 22nd of April.
sentences.zh: 调查持续了三天，于4月22日结束。

sentences.en: Coroner Mr Looms was of the belief that there must be somebody who could shed light on the murders.
sentences.zh: 验尸官卢姆斯先生认为，一定有人能为谋杀案提供线索。

sentences.en: He went on to say police had already conducted an exhaustive investigation although he still hoped that it could be intensified if that was at all possible.
sentences.zh: 他接着说，警方已经进行了详尽的调查，尽管他仍然希望如果可能的话，调查能进一步加强。

sentences.en: There was no doubt what happened in his mind saying the cause of death is very evident a vicious brutal murder.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，发生的事情毫无疑问，他说死因非常明显，是一起恶毒、残忍的谋杀。

sentences.en: After the inquest police stated that they would be revisiting every page of the police file in hopes of uncovering a vital piece of information that may have been previously
sentences.zh: 调查结束后，警方表示他们将重新审阅警察档案的每一页，希望能发现之前可能被

sentences.en: overlooked.
sentences.zh: 忽略的重要信息。

sentences.en: Unfortunately they didn't uncover anything.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，他们什么也没发现。

sentences.en: Police still held the belief that somebody out there knew something about the case and that person was withholding information
sentences.zh: 警方仍然坚信，有人知道关于此案的情况，而那个人隐瞒了信息，

sentences.en: either because they were protecting someone who was close to them or they were in fear of that
sentences.zh: 要么是因为他们在保护亲近的人，要么是因为他们害怕

sentences.en: person they were protecting or they were too embarrassed or scared to come forward for whatever reason it was that they were at the Sandhills that day.
sentences.zh: 他们所保护的那个人，或者是因为他们感到尴尬或害怕而不敢站出来，无论他们那天出现在沙丘的原因是什么。

sentences.en: The six sketches that police had released prior were made into full-size lifelike dummies which were displayed at the Sydney Easter Show in 1967.
sentences.zh: 警方之前发布的六张素描被制作成了真人大小的仿真模型，并在1967年的悉尼复活节展（Sydney Easter Show）上展出。

sentences.en: It was hoped that the large crowds that poured through the Easter Show every year would be able to put names to the faces but no one could.
sentences.zh: 人们希望每年涌入复活节展的大量人群能够认出这些面孔，但没有人能做到。

sentences.en: On the 17th of March 67 another woman was attacked at Wunder Beach.
sentences.zh: 1967年3月17日，另一名女性在万达海滩遇袭。

sentences.en: 28-year-old Brenda Galvan was sunbathing on the beach with her three children when she was attacked by an unknown male person.
sentences.zh: 28岁的布伦达·加尔文（Brenda Galvan）带着三个孩子在海滩上晒太阳时，遭到一名身份不明男子的袭击。

sentences.en: A witness Trevor
sentences.zh: 目击者特雷弗·贝茨（Trevor Betts）

sentences.en: Betts rushed to her aid and the attacker fled.
sentences.zh: 冲过去救她，袭击者逃跑了。

sentences.zh: 尽管在目前这个时间点，这种希望可能非常渺茫。

sentences.en: Those people, what they saw or heard, They might even think that it was insignificant and wouldn't help in the investigation, so there's no use coming forward and risking exposure.
sentences.zh: 那些人，他们所见或所闻，可能觉得那微不足道，对调查没有帮助，所以觉得没必要站出来冒着被曝光的风险。

sentences.en: But it could be the vital piece of missing information that's needed to solve the case and bring closure to the families of Christine and Marianne.
sentences.zh: 但这可能是解决案件并给克里斯汀和玛丽安的家人一个交代所需要的关键缺失信息。

sentences.en: The case is still as frightening today as it would have been back then and affected a great deal of people.
sentences.zh: 这起案件在今天看来依然像当年一样令人恐惧，并影响了很多人。

sentences.en: Obviously, the families, that goes without saying, but even the detectives, the police that were close to the investigation, it really affected a lot of them.
sentences.zh: 显然，受影响的首先是受害者的家人，这不用多说，但即使是那些参与调查的侦探和警察，也深受其影响。

sentences.en: Now, a lot of people close to the case have passed on and are no longer with us, but the case still remains unsolved and let's just hope that it's solved in one day,
sentences.zh: 现在，许多与此案密切相关的人已经去世，离开了我们，但案件仍然悬而未决，让我们祈祷它终有一天能被破获，

sentences.en: whether it be a DNA breakthrough or some vital piece of information that comes forward or something.
sentences.zh: 无论是通过DNA技术的突破，还是因为某条关键信息的出现，或其他什么方式。

sentences.en: Until then, may Marianne and Christine rest in peace.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，愿玛丽安和克里斯汀安息。
